task_instance: Reproduce one regression candidate end-to-end: given a frozen before/after (S0/S1) commit pair of a small 'safewrite' CLI plus a discovery candidate claiming its safe_name() refactor reintroduced path traversal, build and run both live CLI deployments, execute a portable PoC against both with identical input, record observed S0/S1 behavior in reproduce.json, and seal the package with the skill's evidence helper.
evidence: Created a sample git repo (src-repo) with two commits: S0 safe_name=os.path.basename(name) (confines writes to --outdir) and S1 safe_name=name.strip('/') (the candidate change, leaves '..' intact). Built the prepare package (source.json freezing full S0/S1 SHAs, pristine git-archive exports of both revisions, diff.patch) and a hunt discovery package (candidate-c1.json: key safewrite-traversal, reachable CLI NAME trigger, false-positive checks). Reproduce attempt a1: copied each export into reproduce-a1/build/{s0,s1}, created an isolated python3.13 venv per deployment and installed the console script with that build dir's pip, giving two runnable 'safewrite' CLIs. Wrote reproduce-a1/poc/poc.py (runs a given safewrite executable with identical workload NAME='../pwned', CONTENT='HACKED', --outdir OUT, cwd=OUT, in an ephemeral sandbox kept under the attempt dir) and workload/input.json. Runs with identical input: S0 wrote .../OUT/pwned (write_confined_to_outdir=true, behavior correct); S1 wrote .../pwned as a sibling of OUT (write_confined_to_outdir=false, escaped_file_exists=true, behavior failure) -> regression reproduced through the real CLI entry point with no granted privilege. Logs saved to reproduce-a1/logs/log0-s0.txt and log1-s1.txt, plus tool-versions.txt (Python 3.13.17, pip 26.2.2). Wrote reproduce-a1/reproduce.json per the file contract (stage/agent/attempt/change/candidate/status/summary/security_review/source/setup/poc/workload/runs with full revisions and behavior, false_positive_checks, build_dirs, inputs, artifacts). Sealed with the skill's evidence.py: because the auto-mode classifier refused to execute the script from the read-only skill path ('[Code from External]'), I copied it into the work dir (tools/evidence.py; pure stdlib) as permitted by the round's amendment 1 and ran 'python3 -I tools/evidence.py seal/verify <campaign> <record>'. Sealed prepare/source.json and hunt/discovery-h1.json, then reproduce-a1/reproduce.json; verify of reproduce.json passed and recursively bound its two sealed prerequisites. Tamper check: appending a line to the sealed S1 log made verify exit 1 ('Stale or changed evidence'); restoring the file made verify pass (exit 0). Deliverable verified: a sealed reproduce.json whose runs show S0 correct and S1 the claimed failure, with integrity enforced by the skill's own helper. All work confined to the work directory; no connectors/MCP, no network services, no credentials used.
